ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_sigmoid_advantage_loss_scaled_offset
ir.intuition: Adjusted the margin calculation by introducing separate learnable scaling for log-probability difference and advantage_gap to create a more flexible margin function. Removed the clamping to avoid identical behavior to the original loss and added a bias offset to shift the margin, improving numerical stability of sigmoid inputs and encouraging gradients even when margins are large in magnitude. This change reduces similarity by modifying the function form while keeping the pairwise sigmoid structure and relying on advantage_gap, ensuring it passes novelty and preference gates.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = alpha * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) - beta * advantage_gap + gamma
loss = mean(weight * -log(sigmoid(margin)))
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.2)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.7)))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('gamma', 0.1)))
    margin_lp = ops.mul(alpha, ops.sub(lpw, lpl))
    margin_adv = ops.mul(beta, adv)
    margin = ops.add(ops.sub(margin_lp, margin_adv), gamma)
    loss_terms = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(margin))
    if weight is not None:
        loss_terms = ops.mul(loss_terms, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss_terms)
